name: Eiga Go-toubun no Hanayome ~Kimi to Sugoshita Itsutsu no Omoide~
original_name: 映画 五等分の花嫁　～君と過ごした五つの思い出～
source:
The Quintessential Quintuplets the Movie: Five Memories of My Time with You features a multi-ending story that changes depending on which sister you confess your feelings to. It is every The Quintessential Quintuplets fan’s dream situation: "[url=/c94551]Uesugi Fuutarou[/url] confesses his feelings to each of the five sisters." The player can craft Uesugi Fuutarou’s future with their own hands. There are 15 possible endings. Plus, there is a hidden route that can be unlocked after watching the ending for each of the five sisters, allowing you to enjoy the game many times over.

The game also features an original story set during a graduation trip to Okinawa. The player, Uesugi Fuutarou, goes sightseeing in Okinawa with the five sisters. It even features live-action sightseeing movies, so you can feel as if you are really on a trip to Okinawa with the five sisters. During the trip, Fuutarou strives to kiss the one he confesses to and secure a future for his long-distance relationship. Will he get his kiss? That depends on the player.

[Edited from [url=https://www.gematsu.com/2022/02/the-quintessential-quintuplets-the-movie-five-memories-of-my-time-with-you-announced-for-ps4-switch]Gematsu[/url]]
translation:
《电影五等分的新娘～与你共度的五个回忆～》采用多结局剧情，会根据你向哪一位姐妹告白而产生变化。“[url=/c94551]上杉风太郎[/url]分别向五姐妹表白心意”，正是每位《五等分的新娘》粉丝梦寐以求的情境。玩家能够亲手塑造上杉风太郎的未来。游戏共有15种结局，此外，在看过五姐妹各自的结局后，还能解锁隐藏路线，让你反复享受游戏的乐趣。

本作还收录了以冲绳毕业旅行为背景的原创故事。玩家扮演上杉风太郎，与五姐妹一同游览冲绳。游戏甚至收录了实拍观光影像，让人仿佛真的与五姐妹结伴旅行。考虑到今后将开始远距离恋爱，风太郎努力在旅途中亲吻自己的告白对象，稳固两人的未来。他能如愿献上一吻吗？这就取决于玩家了。
